definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of optometry is defined as diagnosing and treating optical deficiency, optical deformity, visual anomaly, muscular anomaly or disease of the human eye and adjacent tissue by prescribing, providing, adapting or fitting lenses or by prescribing, providing, adapting or fitting non-corrective contact lenses, or by prescribing or providing orthoptics or vision training, or by prescribing and using drugs.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of optometry is defined as diagnosing and treating optical deficiency, optical deformity, visual anomaly, muscular anomaly or disease of the human eye and adjacent tissue by prescribing, providing, adapting or fitting lenses or by prescribing, providing, adapting or fitting non-corrective contact lenses, or by prescribing or providing orthoptics or vision training, or by prescribing and using drugs.

drug_authority.value: The use of drugs by optometrists is authorized only in accordance with the provisions of this article and regulations promulgated by the commissioner; includes diagnostic pharmaceuticals, topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for glaucoma/ocular hypertension, and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents (with certification).
drug_authority.quote: The use of drugs by optometrists is authorized only in accordance with the provisions of this article and regulations promulgated by the commissioner.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include any injection or invasive modality. For purposes of this section invasive modality means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or other means. Invasive modality includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.

surgery_definition.value: Invasive modality means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or other means, and includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.
surgery_definition.quote: invasive modality means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or other means. Invasive modality includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Invasive modality includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Those optometrists having been certified for therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for treatment of glaucoma and ocular hypertension shall be authorized to use and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for treatment of glaucoma and ocular hypertension

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: by prescribing or providing orthoptics or vision training

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents shall mean those orally administered drugs used for therapeutic purposes solely for the treatment of diseases of the eye and adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: The commissioner shall issue appropriate certificates to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in accordance with the provisions of this section to those optometrists who have satisfactorily completed a curriculum in general and ocular pharmacology

value: Therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for treatment of glaucoma and ocular hypertension certification
specialty_certification_types.quote: The commissioner shall issue appropriate certificates to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in accordance with the provisions of this section

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: each optometrist shall have completed at least three hundred hours of clinical training in the diagnosis, treatment and management of patients with ocular disease other than glaucoma and ocular hypertension

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: each optometrist shall have completed at least three hundred hours of clinical training in the diagnosis, treatment and management of patients with ocular disease

referral_to_physician_required.quote: an optometrist may use or prescribe a maximum of one twenty-four hour prescription and shall immediately refer the patient to a licensed physician specializing in diseases of the eye

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: After the initial diagnosis of glaucoma or ocular hypertension and before initiating treatment of any patient, an optometrist shall engage in a written consultation with a licensed physician specializing in diseases of the eye.

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: A person in training or appropriately trained and deemed qualified by the supervising licensed optometrist, to assist a licensed optometrist in the care of a patient for the purpose of instilling mydriatic or cycloplegic eye drops and anesthetic eye drops

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: There shall be appointed within the department, by the board of regents, a committee on drug and alcohol abuse, which shall advise the board of regents on matters relating to practice by professional licensees with drug or alcohol abuse problems

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: An optometrist licensed in another state or country who is employed on a full-time basis by a registered school of optometry as a faculty member with the rank of assistant professor or higher from conducting research and clinical demonstrations as part of such employment
